scope: Loopback-only Chromium with a virtual authenticator. All participants are automation; none are human controls.

scenarios.name: Declared automation / observe
scenarios.description: A real automated Chromium browser completes the production passkey interface. Observe mode records its signals.

scenarios.name: Declared browser / enforce
scenarios.description: The browser declares HeadlessChrome in its user agent. Enforce mode rejects access.

scenarios.name: WebDriver signal / enforce
scenarios.description: An ordinary-looking user agent still reports navigator.webdriver=true. The registration attempt is rejected.

scenarios.name: Suppressed signals / enforce
scenarios.description: A controlled test hides both declarations. Automation gets through with an invitation and a virtual passkey; extraction budgets still apply.
